problem:
Find the general solution to the equation $\operatorname{tan}⁡x=\sqrt{3}$ in the form $x=\theta +n\cdot b$ where $\theta \in [0,{180}^{∘}),$ $n$ is an integer and $b$ is the period in degrees.

$x=$
{{field-1}}${}^{∘}+\,n\,\cdot $
{{field-2}}${}^{∘}$
worked_solution:
First, we find the principal value:

$$
{x}_{1}=arctan\,(\sqrt{3})={60}^{∘}
$$

The tangent function has a period of ${180}^{∘}.$  Hence, the general solution for the given equation is

$$
x={60}^{∘}+n\cdot {180}^{∘}.
$$
